turns.question: What was the ratio of non-cancelled order revenue to total ad spend in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no ratio metric for revenue per ad euro, and I don't compute figures myself; the closest metrics are revenue_eur and ad_spend_eur, and for 1-30 September 2026 revenue (non-cancelled orders) was 12,582.75 EUR and ad spend was 6,270.00 EUR. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
